title: Completely Wrong Facts Everyone Still Believes (Long Listen)
desc: Twelve popular beliefs about the mind, checked against the research: the 21-day habit, sugar and hyperactivity, the full moon, multitasking, learning in your sleep, adult brain cells, spotting liars, group brainstorming, power poses, willpower, birth order and sex differences. Every verdict comes from named studies, and the doubts are left in. A calm, sourced listen for the evening.
plan: b02: sugar and children (Wolraich 1995, Hoover & Milich 1994)
b03: full moon (Rotton & Kelly 1985, Cajochen 2013, Cordi 2014)
b05: sleep learning (Simon & Emmons 1956, Antony 2012, Arzi 2012)
b06: adult neurogenesis (Eriksson 1998, Spalding 2013, Sorrells 2018, Maguire 2000)
b07: lie detection (Bond & DePaulo 2006, NRC 2003, Vrij 2006)
b12: sex differences (Hyde 2005, Mehl 2007); takeaways; end
